# Zoom Clinic

> A leading cosmetic surgery and medical tourism clinic in Turkey specializing in rhinoplasty, hair transplants, obesity treatment, and comprehensive aesthetic procedures.

Zoom Clinic is based in Istanbul, Turkey and has been providing cosmetic and surgical services since 2012. The clinic offers a full range of procedures from facial and body plastic surgery to dental cosmetics and weight loss treatments, serving international patients seeking affordable, high-quality aesthetic solutions.

## Key Topics

- Rhinoplasty
- Hair Transplant (FUE, DHI, Sapphire)
- Obesity Treatment (Gastric Sleeve, Bypass, Banding, Balloon)
- Body Plastic Surgery (Liposuction, Vaser, Tummy Tuck)
- Facial Plastic Surgery (Facelift, Eyelid Surgery)
- Cosmetic Dentistry (Hollywood Smile, Invisalign, Veneers)
- Medical Tourism
- Cosmetic Surgery Turkey
- Hair Restoration
- Dental Implants
- Teeth Whitening
- Weight Loss Surgery
- Piezoelectric Technique
- Choi Pens
- Hyaluronic Acid

## Cosmetic Surgery Services

- [All Services Overview](https://zoom-clinic.com/zoom-clinic-services): Comprehensive overview of Zoom Clinic's cosmetic and surgical services
- [Rhinoplasty](https://zoom-clinic.com/zoom-clinic-services/rhinoplasty): Rhinoplasty procedures using Piezoelectric technique and Hyaluronic acid
- [Facial Plastic Surgery](https://zoom-clinic.com/zoom-clinic-services/facial-plastic-surgery): Facial procedures including facelift, eyelid surgery, and chin augmentation
- [Body Plastic Surgery](https://zoom-clinic.com/zoom-clinic-services/body-plastic-surgery): Body procedures: liposuction, Vaser sculpting, tummy tuck, and breast augmentation

## Hair Restoration & Dental Services

- [Hair Transplant](https://zoom-clinic.com/zoom-clinic-services/hair-transplant): Hair transplant services: FUE, DHI, Sapphire FUE using Choi pens
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://zoom-clinic.com/zoom-clinic-services/cosmetic-dental-surgeries): Cosmetic dental services: Hollywood Smile, Invisalign, and Porcelain Veneers

## Weight Loss & Obesity Treatment

- [Obesity Treatment](https://zoom-clinic.com/zoom-clinic-services/obesity-treatment): Obesity treatment services including Gastric Sleeve, Bypass, Banding, and Balloon procedures
